blocks.text: P-Pop girl group XONARA showcased what authentic, flavorful vibes taste like at their first-ever Bonchon Fanverse in SM Fairview, following the successful launch of their brand ambassadorship for the Eat 7 campaign. As the new faces of the original Korean chicken favorite of Filipinos, XONARA brings to life the seven classic Korean ‘chikin’ flavors of Bonchon—each matching the members’ distinct vibes and personalities. Lucky fans got to indulge in the ultimate fan meet experience, enjoying up-close interactions and memorable moments with XONARA. Every XONARA member brings one Bonchon flavor to life with an undeniable vibe: Eurekah’s bold and creative spirit shines […]...
